claims.originating_goal: Build the presentation-only Site surface for governed real-time U.S. household economic conditions with longitudinal comparison to 2000 or the earliest methodologically comparable date.
claims.claim_expires_when: Release after the fail-closed page shell and fixture contract are validated, the ERL source contract is accepted, Site orchestration gates pass, README/handoff state is reconciled, and the bounded integration merges. Public activation remains separately gated on authentic governed ERL output and served-body proof.
expected_evidence: normalized index mode supports 2000-to-now range without fabricating unavailable history
methodology and coverage breaks remain visible
no live economic finding or deployment claim
collision_boundaries: Do not replace or duplicate Physical-Economics.html report engine
Do not create economic findings in Site
Do not silently splice incompatible historical series
Do not infer household welfare from nominal spending, GDP/productivity, gross weekly earnings, or aggregate DSR
No public activation from source/CI state
claims.next_task_after_release: Bind the Site surface to authentic governed ERL household-state output, validate freshness/methodology metadata, then perform separate public served-body verification before activation.
